result.reason: The redline improves the Software warranty period to the 90-day fallback duration and removes the fixed 1999 expiration, but neither complete position is achieved. It omits professional-and-workmanlike and legal-compliance warranties, lacks general Deliverables coverage, narrows the malicious-code warranty, and provides only reasonable efforts rather than a firm repair obligation. The duration change is targeted and does not disturb unrelated commercial terms, but the redline is not complete enough to be minimal for either acceptable level.
